# Green Sunsure Energy

> Green Sunsure Energy Solution And Technology Ltd is a Nigerian solar energy company in Warri, Delta State that designs, installs, and maintains solar power systems for homes and businesses.

Green Sunsure Energy helps Nigerian homeowners and businesses reduce fuel and generator costs, enjoy uninterrupted electricity, and receive long-term support after installation. Head office: 53 Udu Road, opposite Rainoil filling station, close to Udu Bridge, beside GKM, Warri, Delta State, Nigeria. Phone: +234 903 826 0459. Email: info@greensunsure.com. Hours: Mon-Sat 8am-6pm, Sunday closed.

## Services
- Solar panel sales & installation
- Commercial & residential solar solutions
- Battery backup & inverter systems
- Solar maintenance & repairs
- Solar CCTV & security systems
- Energy audits & consultation
- Certified solar technician training

## Key facts
- 500+ happy clients
- 15+ engineers
- 650+ projects completed
- 4.9 average client rating
- NERC & ISO accredited
- Areas served: Warri, Delta State, Effurun, Udu, and all 36 states with certified installers in major cities
